1.title: Shibuya Hikarie "Christmas Food & Drink Fair 2026"
1.summary: A fair offering Christmas-limited menus at 25 cafés and restaurants on the 6th, 7th and 11th floors of Shibuya Hikarie will be held from November 5 to December 25, 2026. During the period, original cards with coupons will also be given out.
1.body:
The "Christmas Food & Drink Fair 2026" will be held at 25 cafés and restaurants on the 6th, 7th and 11th floors of Shibuya Hikarie. This year's fair features "HikariELF," and each shop is preparing Christmas-themed menu items.

## Fair Details

- **25 cafés and restaurants** on the 6th, 7th and 11th floors will offer Christmas menus
- During the period, **original cards with coupons** featuring HikariELF will be given out
- A list of participating shops and menus can be found in the PDF on the official website

Directly connected to Shibuya Station, it is easy to drop by on your way home from work or while shopping. At the restaurants on the upper floors, you can enjoy a Christmas dinner together with the night view of Shibuya.

## Event Information

- **Period**: November 5 (Thu) – December 25 (Fri), 2026
- **Venue**: Shibuya Hikarie 6F, 7F, 11F Cafés & Restaurants (2-21-1 Shibuya, Shibuya-ku, Tokyo)

Menu contents and serving periods may vary by shop, so we recommend checking the official website before your visit.

2.title: The 29th Mitsuhiko Sasao Exhibition: "Landscapes with Flowers"
2.summary: A solo exhibition by Mitsuhiko Sasao, known as the "Painter of Red," will be held at Bunkamura Gallery 8/ on the 8th floor of Shibuya Hikarie from November 12 to 29, 2026. A collage exhibition by Tsugumi Sasao will be held concurrently in the adjacent venue.
2.body:
The solo exhibition "The 29th Mitsuhiko Sasao Exhibition: Landscapes with Flowers," featuring the painter Mitsuhiko Sasao, who depicts vivid reds, flowers, and the charm of Paris, will be held at Bunkamura Gallery 8/ on the 8th floor of Shibuya Hikarie.

This is his 29th exhibition counting from his first solo show in 1998. A 30th anniversary exhibition is planned for next year, so this show comes ahead of the milestone of 30 years since he came to be called the "Painter of Red."

## Main Series on Display

- The "**Paris Flower Shop**" series, depicting colorful flower shops
- The "**Red Sofa**" series, which led to him being called the "Painter of Red"
- The modern, white-based "**The Shelf**" series
- "**Mini Frame**," small palm-sized oil paintings

## Concurrent Event: "Tsugumi Sasao Collage Exhibition"

At the neighboring venue, "Creative Lounge MOV - SHOWCASE aiiima 2" (8th floor, Shibuya Hikarie), the "Tsugumi Sasao Collage Exhibition" will also be held for five days only, from Thursday, November 12 to Monday, November 16, 2026.

## Event Details

- **Dates**: Thursday, November 12 – Sunday, November 29, 2026
- **Hours**: 11:00–20:00
- **Venue**: Bunkamura Gallery 8/ (8th floor, Shibuya Hikarie)

Information on how sales will be handled on the first day will be provided on the Bunkamura Gallery 8/ website.

3.title: UNION EXPO 2026 (Shibuya Hikarie Hall)
3.summary: UNION EXPO 2026, a hands-on event showcasing the present and future of space creation, will be held on November 8, 2026 at Hikarie Hall on the 9th floor of Shibuya Hikarie. Admission is free with advance registration required, and there are also making activities for children.
3.body:
UNION EXPO 2026, a hands-on event where the Union Tech Group and a variety of partner companies present the present and future possibilities of space creation, will be held at Hikarie Hall in Shibuya Hikarie.

## Highlights

- Exhibits of cutting-edge technology, including Honda's mobility robot "**UNI-ONE**"
- **Design and crafting experiences** taught by professionals
- A program where children, the next generation, can experience the "city and spaces of the future"

Open to the public, **admission is free**. Advance registration is required, so be sure to sign up on the official website.

## Event Details

- **Date & Time**: Sunday, November 8, 2026, 10:30–18:00
- **Venue**: Shibuya Hikarie 9F, Hikarie Hall, Halls A and B
- **Admission**: Free (advance registration required)
- **Capacity**: 3,000 people

Since it is a hands-on event that parents and children can enjoy together, it would make a great weekend outing.

4.title: d47 MUSEUM: Aichi's "Masukichi" and Seto Ware
4.summary: At d47 MUSEUM on the 8th floor of Shibuya Hikarie, a special feature is on view through November 11, 2026. It introduces Seto ware vessels you can discover through "Masukichi," an inn in Seto, Aichi Prefecture.
4.body:
At d47 MUSEUM on the 8th floor of Shibuya Hikarie, a special feature titled "Aichi 'Masukichi' and Seto Ware" is being held in connection with the 38th exhibition, "THE 47 PEOPLE OF NIPPON 2026 CULTURAL STAY."

## About the Feature

"THE 47 PEOPLE OF NIPPON 2026 CULTURAL STAY" is an exhibition introducing 47 hosts ("aruji") who nurture local culture through inns in each of Japan's 47 prefectures. This feature focuses on **Masukichi**, an inn in Seto City, presented as the representative for Aichi Prefecture.

Masukichi is a base where visitors can fully experience the charm of Seto, a town of ceramics, through stays, a café, town-walking tours, and more. The venue presents vessels by Seto makers whom you can encounter through Masukichi. In Seto, which is blessed with excellent pottery clay, you can pick up and see for yourself the character of vessels born from each maker's techniques and ingenuity.

## Details

- **Dates**: Friday, October 23, 2026 – Wednesday, November 11, 2026
- **Hours**: 12:00–20:00
- **Venue**: d47 MUSEUM (8th floor, Shibuya Hikarie)

This exhibition lets you experience craftsmanship from across Japan, so it's a nice place to stop by between shopping in Shibuya.

5.title: SAITO KIYOSHI MEET AGAIN, MEET NEW
5.summary: A special exhibition of Kiyoshi Saito, a leading figure in postwar Japanese contemporary printmaking, will be held at 8/CUBE in Shibuya Hikarie from December 3 to 13, 2026, for the first time in about seven years.
5.body:
Born in Aizu, Fukushima Prefecture, printmaker Kiyoshi Saito (1907–97) showed the world the strength of Japanese contemporary prints soon after the war. His special exhibition "SAITO KIYOSHI MEET AGAIN, MEET NEW" will be held at 8/CUBE on the 8th floor of Shibuya Hikarie. It is the first special exhibition at Shibuya Hikarie in about seven years.

## An Exhibition Ahead of the 120th Anniversary of His Birth

2027 will mark the 120th anniversary of Kiyoshi Saito's birth and the 30th anniversary of the opening of the Yanaizu Town Saito Kiyoshi Museum of Art, a museum dedicated to his work. This exhibition was planned ahead of these milestones.

His diverse expressive techniques and refined sense of form, which were highly acclaimed mainly in Europe and the United States, still leave a vivid impression today. The exhibition offers a reunion for those who were once drawn to his works, and a new encounter for those who do not yet know them.

## Event Details

- **Dates**: Thursday, December 3 – Sunday, December 13, 2026
- **Hours**: 11:00–20:00 (until 18:00 on the final day)
- **Venue**: Shibuya Hikarie 8/CUBE

The exhibition runs for only 11 days, so be sure to add it to your schedule so you don't miss it.

6.title: Super Welfare School @SHIBUYA 2026
6.summary: "Super Welfare School @SHIBUYA 2026," an event aiming for a society where everyone learns and lives together, will be held at Shibuya Hikarie starting November 26, 2026. Over four days, it will feature 18 symposiums and an exhibition experience, the "Super Welfare Library," with free admission.
6.body:
"Super Welfare School @SHIBUYA 2026," an event themed around a "super welfare" place of learning that breaks away from conventional welfare, will be held on the 8th floor of Shibuya Hikarie. This year's theme is "Leap Beyond to Learn. Learn and Connect."

## Symposiums (8/COURT)

A total of **18 symposiums** will be held over four days. A wide variety of guests who leap beyond the boundaries of welfare and education will take the stage, sharing the latest initiatives and case studies from across Japan from Shibuya. The speaker lineup will be announced progressively on the official website and official social media.

## Exhibition Experience "Super Welfare Library" (8/CUBE)

The theme is an "inclusive indoor public space" that blends a park, library, art museum, and museum, where everyone can play and learn side by side. The exhibition gathers content that can be enjoyed with all five senses, with an awareness of neurodiversity and "senses."

## Event Details

- **Symposiums**: Thursday, November 26, 2026 – Sunday, November 29, 2026, 11:00–20:30 (ends at 18:30 on the final day) / 8/COURT
- **Super Welfare Library**: Thursday, November 26, 2026 – Tuesday, December 1, 2026 / 8/CUBE
- **Venue**: Shibuya Hikarie, 8th Floor
- **Admission**: Free, no advance registration required

7.title: "VU! VI" Art Lab Group Art Show
7.summary: "VU! VI," a group exhibition of artists affiliated with or connected to two art labs in North Aoyama and South Aoyama, will be held at 8/CUBE in Shibuya Hikarie from November 17 to 24, 2026.
7.body:
Art Lab Tokyo in North Aoyama and Satellites Art Lab in South Aoyama. "VU! VI" (pronounced "Vu-6!"), a group art show bringing together notable artists from these two art labs in North and South Aoyama, will be held at 8/CUBE in Shibuya Hikarie.

## The 7th Art Show in the Series

The series began with the group art show "Mustanglers," followed by its successor "VU!", the "DAHA!" exhibition held in autumn 2020 during the pandemic, and then "VU! 2," "VU! 3," "VU! 4," and "VU! 5." This is the 7th installment in the series.

The venue will feature new works and sculptural pieces by regular artists, as well as artworks created with distinctive techniques. It is a chance to see new works and representative pieces by affiliated and associated artists all at once.

## Event Details

- **Dates**: Tuesday, November 17, 2026 – Tuesday, November 24, 2026
- **Hours**: 11:00–20:00
- **Venue**: Shibuya Hikarie 8/CUBE 1, 2 & 3

Be sure to also visit 8/ARCHIVES on the same floor.

8.title: MES Solo Exhibition "RE-I" (PARCO MUSEUM TOKYO)
8.summary: "RE-I," a solo exhibition by the artist duo MES, who also work as laser VJs at Shibuya clubs, is on now through November 16, 2026 at PARCO MUSEUM TOKYO on the 4th floor of Shibuya PARCO. A free talk event will also be held on November 8.
8.body:
A solo exhibition titled "RE-I" by **MES**, the artist duo of Ken Arai and Kanae Tanigawa, is now on at PARCO MUSEUM TOKYO on the 4th floor of Shibuya PARCO. Created by MES, who have been based in Shibuya, and PARCO, which has long shared culture from Shibuya, the exhibition is an attempt to view the ever-changing city of Shibuya from a new angle.

## Picking up Shibuya's forgotten history from "Rei"

Since 2015, MES have worked around contemporary art and club culture, and have also been active as laser VJs at many clubs in Shibuya. They have developed a series of works that layer the diverse meanings born from a single word: *SA-I*, *TA-I*, *GA-I*, *DA-I*, and *KA-I*.

For this exhibition, they pick up Shibuya's forgotten history from words read as "rei": zero (0), spirit, cold, Ray (light beam), layer, and rave, and reflect it into the present through physical action. In February 2027, they will hold a solo exhibition at the Museum of Contemporary Art Los Angeles in the U.S.

## Opening Commemorative Talk "MES × Chim↑Pom from Smappa!Group"

- **Date & Time**: Sunday, November 8, 2026, 15:00–16:30
- **Admission**: Free (seating for the first 30 people; standing room after that)
- The venue will close once at 14:30 on the day for setup, and will reopen as usual at 17:00

## Exhibition Details

- **Dates**: Saturday, October 24 – Monday, November 16, 2026
- **Venue**: PARCO MUSEUM TOKYO (4F, Shibuya PARCO)

9.title: HERALBONY POP UP "Heartdemic" (Shibuya PARCO)
9.summary: A pop-up by HERALBONY, a brand that brings art by artists with intellectual disabilities to society, is on now on the 1st floor of Shibuya PARCO through November 15, 2026. The theme is "The Spread of Heartbeats and Kindness – Heartdemic."
9.body:
The pop-up store "Heartdemic" by HERALBONY, a brand that brings unique art created mainly by artists with intellectual disabilities to society, is being held at POP UP SPACE "ARCADE" on the 1st floor of Shibuya PARCO.

## This Season's Theme: "The Spread of Heartbeats and Kindness"

The lineup ranges from items featuring the "♡♡♡ (Triple Heart)" icon of three connected hearts to items that let you wear the presence of art through craft techniques, such as weaves inspired by the colors of the artworks.

## Featured Items

- [HEART] Embroidered Smooth Hoodie (Off-White) 25,300 yen
- Shirt "Gakufu No.2" (Sheet Music No.2) with artwork by Koji Nishioka expressed in embroidery, 52,800 yen
- [HEART] Embroidery Knit Cap Black 9,900 yen
- Overcoat with artwork by monica woven as a single picture in jacquard, 165,000 yen
- [HEART] Custom charm set, with a customizable heart-motif carabiner, 9,350 yen (limited quantity)

On Thursday, November 5 during the event, HERALBONY × BRUTUS will also hold the art & music session "Afurete, Utsuru." at PBOX STND on the 10th floor.

## Event Details

- **Period**: Tuesday, November 3, 2026 (national holiday) – Sunday, November 15, 2026
- **Venue**: Shibuya PARCO 1F POP UP SPACE "ARCADE"

10.title: Tetsuya Nagato RAREMETAL POP UP STORE “Knowledge”
10.summary: A pop-up for “Knowledge,” the new collection from RAREMETAL, the project of art director Tetsuya Nagato, is on view through November 15, 2026 at NONLECTURE books/arts, Shibuya PARCO ZEROGATE B1F.
10.body:
The 26WINTER COLLECTION “Knowledge” POP UP STORE by **RAREMETAL**, a project led by Tetsuya Nagato, an art director active across a wide range of fields including advertising, fashion, and music, is now being held at NONLECTURE books/arts on the B1F of Shibuya PARCO ZEROGATE.

## New Apparel and ZINEs on Display

The venue features the new apparel collection “Knowledge” as well as publications from **IRUBOOKS**, the ZINE label run by Nagato.

RAREMETAL is a project in which apparel and ZINEs are created freely, as the mood strikes, based on everyday images and fragments the artist has gathered. It also holds live performances from time to time. It is an attempt to discover the small pieces we would normally overlook, moving spontaneously across clothing, printed matter, and sound.

## Opening Event

On the first day, Wednesday, November 4, from 19:00 to 21:00, Nagato will be present at the venue and perform an improvised set of faint noise.

## Event Details

- **Dates**: Wednesday, November 4 – Sunday, November 15, 2026
- **Hours**: 12:00–21:00
- **Venue**: NONLECTURE books/arts (Shibuya PARCO ZEROGATE B1F)

11.title: Shibuya PARCO 7th Anniversary "BORDER/SHIBUYA" Starts November 20
11.summary: Shibuya PARCO's 7th anniversary project "BORDER/SHIBUYA" will run from November 20 to 29, 2026. On opening night, enjoy the OPENING PARTY with DJs and catering throughout the building, plus "Gakuen Tengoku," which transforms the 4th floor into a one-night-only classroom.
11.body:
Shibuya PARCO celebrates its 7th anniversary in November 2026 with the anniversary project "**SHIBUYA PARCO 7th Anniversary BORDER/SHIBUYA**." The theme is "Crossing Nameless Borders." The key visual features contemporary artist GILLOCHINDOX☆GILLOCHINDAE.

During the period, shops will sell limited-edition items and host events with artists from Japan and abroad. This year, the project goes beyond the building, with events taking place simultaneously across the whole of Shibuya.

## Opening Night, Friday, November 20: "OPENING PARTY"

A one-night-only event with DJ events and catering on floors throughout the building. From B1F to the upper floors, each shop has prepared programs such as DJs, drinks, novelties, and photo booths.

## 4F Becomes a One-Night-Only Classroom: "Gakuen Tengoku"

The classroom of the students who appear in the "class photo" of the 7th anniversary visual will appear in the 4F atrium area on the day of the party. In a classroom set up with desks and chairs, a teacher's desk, and a blackboard, lessons, break times, and club activities proceed according to a timetable, with "teachers" from various fields standing at the lectern. All visitors can take part as "transfer students."

- **Date & Time**: Friday, November 20, 2026, 18:00–21:00
- **Venue**: Shibuya PARCO 4F Atrium Area

## Event Details

- **Period**: Friday, November 20 – Sunday, November 29, 2026
- **Venue**: Throughout Shibuya PARCO (15-1 Udagawacho, Shibuya-ku, Tokyo)

12.title: Shibuya PARCO to Renovate About 20 Spaces, Including a New "CDG" Shop on the 2nd Floor and the World's First "PALACE BASICALLY A KIOSK"
12.summary: Shibuya PARCO will renovate about 20 spaces (370 tsubo) in autumn 2026. On November 20, a new "CDG" concept shop, "WILDSIDE YOHJI YAMAMOTO," and the world's first format from PALACE SKATEBOARDS will open on the 2nd floor.
12.body:
Shibuya PARCO will carry out a renovation of about 20 spaces (370 tsubo) in autumn 2026. Following the large-scale renovation of about 80 spaces in 2025, the theme is "**Asserting Deconstruction (Re) Construction**." Under this theme, which reinterprets the words of PARCO founder Tsuji Masuda, the renovation will enhance the character of each floor in terms of both fashion and culture.

## 2F "MODE & ART" Welcomes Notable Shops

- **CDG**: A new concept shop for "CDG," the diffusion line of COMME des GARÇONS. Popular items and store-exclusive items are condensed into a space of just 8 tsubo. Opens Friday, November 20
- **WILDSIDE YOHJI YAMAMOTO**: A project created by Yohji Yamamoto that collaborates with various brands and artists. Opens Friday, November 20
- **PALACE BASICALLY A KIOSK**: The world's first format from "PALACE SKATEBOARDS," the skate brand from London
- **Dries Van Noten**: The brand from Antwerp, Belgium, is scheduled to open in January 2027

## 5F Expands "CHAOS CULTURE GEEK"

On the 5th floor, additions such as "Vans Store Shibuya," a symbol of skate culture, will further expand the floor concept "CHAOS CULTURE GEEK." "THE GUNDAM BASE SHIBUYA" will also open on this floor on November 20.

To coincide with the unveiling of the renovation, the 7th anniversary event "BORDER/SHIBUYA" will begin on November 20.

13.title: "THE GUNDAM BASE SHIBUYA" to Open on the 5th Floor of Shibuya PARCO on November 20
13.summary: "THE GUNDAM BASE SHIBUYA," the third Tokyo location of the Gunpla complex "THE GUNDAM BASE," will open on the 5th floor of Shibuya PARCO on November 20, 2026. It features an interior inspired by Shibuya culture and "SHIBUYA COLLECTION," a product area whose lineup changes every month.
13.body:
BANDAI SPIRITS Hobby Division will open a new store, "**THE GUNDAM BASE SHIBUYA**," on the 5th floor of Shibuya PARCO on Friday, November 20, 2026. It is the third location in Tokyo, following "THE GUNDAM BASE TOKYO" and "THE GUNDAM BASE TOKYO ANNEX" in Koto-ku, Tokyo.

## Interior Inspired by Shibuya Culture

- A **large LED screen** is installed on the store exterior, showing original footage and 3D videos in which Gunpla and the Shibuya cityscape blend in a pop style
- **Three bust statues** of the "RX-78-2 Gundam," "Strike Freedom Gundam," and "Unicorn Gundam" are placed inside the store
- Graphic designer Toku Yokoyama has rebuilt Gunpla package art with Shibuya as the concept, displayed as large graphics on the walls

## "SHIBUYA COLLECTION" with a Monthly Changing Lineup

The "SHIBUYA COLLECTION" product area features about 15 types of Gunpla, all of which are replaced every month. Visit every month and you will still find new Gunpla.

## Opening Commemorative Campaign

The first 3,000 customers who purchase 5,000 yen (tax included) or more in a single transaction will receive an original sticker featuring Mr. Yokoyama's collaboration art (while supplies last). Entry restrictions by advance lottery are planned right after the opening, so please check the official website before your visit.

- **Opening date**: Friday, November 20, 2026
- **Location**: Shibuya PARCO 5F (15-1 Udagawacho, Shibuya-ku, Tokyo)

14.title: "sanrio house" to Open on the 5th Floor of Shibuya PARCO on November 13
14.summary: "sanrio house," a Sanrio character shop operated by Mash Holdings, will open on the 5th floor of Shibuya PARCO on November 13, 2026.
14.body:
A new "**sanrio house**" store, a Sanrio character shop operated by Mash Holdings, will open on the 5th floor of Shibuya PARCO on Friday, November 13, 2026.

## Opening on the 5th Floor of Shibuya PARCO

The 5th floor of Shibuya PARCO has the floor concept "CHAOS CULTURE GEEK," and is home to shops for games, anime, and characters. "THE GUNDAM BASE SHIBUYA" is also scheduled to open on the same floor on November 20, adding even more to enjoy for visitors who come for characters and hobby items.

## Store Information

- **Opening date**: Friday, November 13, 2026
- **Location**: Shibuya PARCO 5F (15-1 Udagawacho, Shibuya-ku, Tokyo)
- **Hours**: 11:00–21:00

For details on opening commemorative events, limited-edition items, and more, please check the official announcement.

15.title: The 49th Furusato Shibuya Festival 2026 (Yoyogi Park)
15.summary: The "Shibuya Ward Kumin no Hiroba Furusato Shibuya Festival 2026," Shibuya's largest community festival, will be held at Yoyogi Park on November 7 and 8, 2026. About 130 groups will take part, and admission is free.
15.body:
The annual festival "**The 49th Shibuya Ward Kumin no Hiroba Furusato Shibuya Festival 2026**," which aims to strengthen community bonds and showcase Shibuya's local life and culture, will be held at Yoyogi Park.

## A Community Festival with About 130 Participating Groups

About 130 groups will exhibit and perform at the venue, with stage performances, local specialty products from across Japan, and food booths. Activities for all ages include meeting Akita dogs and ponies, sports experiences, and free apple giveaways.

On Sunday the 8th, a parent-and-child soccer clinic will be led by coaches from the development department of the professional soccer team FC Tokyo (advance registration for students of Shibuya Ward public kindergartens, nurseries, and elementary schools). The Outdoor Stage and the Harajuku Gate Stage are also scheduled to be streamed on YouTube Live.

## Event Details

- **Dates**: Saturday, November 7 and Sunday, November 8, 2026
- **Hours**: 10:00–16:00
- **Venue**: Yoyogi Park (2-1 Yoyogikamizonocho, Shibuya-ku, Tokyo)
- **Admission**: Free
- **Access**: About 3 minutes on foot from JR Harajuku Station or Tokyo Metro Chiyoda Line Yoyogi-Koen Station

There is no parking at the venue, so please use public transportation. Traffic restrictions will be in effect in the surrounding area during the parade. Visitors are also asked not to post stage performances to social media or video sites without the performers' permission.

16.title: Yoyogi Forest of Lights ~Forest of Light~
16.summary: From November 13, 2026 to January 11, 2027, Yoyogi Park will host a winter forest-themed illumination event. 17 light zones are spread along a course of approx. 1.8 km.
16.body:
"ACN presents Yoyogi Forest of Lights," a new illumination themed on a European winter forest, will be held for the first time in the cycling course area of Yoyogi Park, starting Friday, November 13, 2026. Unlike illuminations in urban spaces, it offers a magical world of light and sound that makes full use of the park's abundant natural trees.

## Highlights

As you walk along the approx. 1.8 km course, 17 light zones (hero pieces), each with a different look, appear one after another.

- **Singing Tree**: A secret space where the trees sing at night
- **Floral Fantasia**: A space where the trees are adorned with flowers to the famous piece "Waltz of the Flowers"
- **Chestnut Aglow**: A space where the trees are draped in a veil of green light

The experience continues with a wide variety of attractions, including the "Rainbow Road," a path of seven-colored light; a photo spot with a glowing "YOYOGI" sign; the "Laser Lane," enveloped in blue lasers; and the "London Skyline," which recreates London's cityscape.

## Food & Drink

The food area, lined with food trucks and food booths, is scheduled to feature vendors such as "Malins," serving British fish and chips, and "NarraTive," serving tea and scones.

## Event Information

- Dates: Friday, November 13, 2026 – Monday, January 11, 2027 (national holiday)
- Hours: 17:30–22:00 (last entry 21:00)
- Venue: Yoyogi Park (cycling course area)
- Admission for November visits (11/13–11/30) is at an early-bird price, with adult (university student and above) tickets starting from 2,400 yen on some dates. Preschool children enter free when accompanied by a guardian (up to 2 children per guardian).
- Tickets are not sold on the day, so advance ticket purchase is required. The event will be held rain or shine.

17.title: Fiesta de España 2026 (Yoyogi Park)
17.summary: One of Japan's largest Spanish festivals will be held on November 14 and 15 at the Yoyogi Park Event Plaza. Enjoy flamenco, Spanish cuisine, a grand quiz contest, and more.
17.body:
Fiesta de España, which began in 2013 to mark the 400th anniversary of Japan-Spain exchange, returns for its 14th year in 2026 at the Yoyogi Park Event Plaza. It is one of Japan's largest Spanish festivals, bringing together Spanish food, music, flamenco, and culture in one place.

## Highlights

- **Giant-Pan Paella (1,300 yen each)**: On the 14th, seafood paella is served from 11:30 and fiery chorizo paella from 14:30. On the 15th, fiery chorizo paella is served from 11:30 and seafood paella from 14:30. The one-of-a-kind design drawn on the giant pan before cooking is also a popular photo spot.
- **Flamenco Stage**: Los Topos performs on the 14th and Los Amigos on the 15th, with clapping and shouts of "¡Olé!" lighting up the whole venue.
- **Sevillanas Contest**: A serious competition where dancers vie with the skill and passion of this traditional Spanish dance.

## Food & Drink

A wide variety of booths will line the venue, including Spanish dishes by Paella Ojiichan, Estrella Galicia beer from Galicia, and Spanish wine.

## Grand Quiz Contest

From around 14:40 on the 15th, a audience-participation quiz contest will be held on the main stage, with round-trip economy-class airline tickets to Spain, sponsored by Turkish Airlines, as the prize.

Hours are 10:00–20:00 (ending at 19:00 on the final day). Held rain or shine; canceled in case of severe weather.

18.title: SHIBUYA SKY Winter Event "Sparkling View"
18.summary: SHIBUYA SKY, the observation facility at Shibuya Scramble Square, will hold its winter-only event "Sparkling View" from November 5 to December 25, 2026. Highlights include a record-largest 550 mirror balloons, plus a rooftop light tree and soap bubble show.
18.body:
SHIBUYA SKY, the observation facility at Shibuya Scramble Square, is holding a special winter-season-only event, **"Sparkling View"**. The theme is "Sparkling winter scenery above Shibuya."

## 46F "SKY GALLERY" — 550 Mirror Balloons

The indoor observation corridor features a record-largest **550 mirror balloons**. They reflect the winter blue sky during the day and the illuminations and night views after dark, creating a space whose colors change moment by moment. Also featured are visuals on a large LED monitor of about 40 m, the original omnidirectional lighting "NEBULA," and a sound presentation by sound artist evala. A "Sparkling Balloon Tree" will also appear at the entrance to the corridor.

## Rooftop "SKY STAGE" — Light Tree and Soap Bubbles

During the event period, after 7:00 p.m., the pillar of light "**Sparkling Light Tree**," rising from the rooftop toward the sky, will be lit up. Every 30 minutes after 7:00 p.m., a "Special Celebration" with light, sound, and countless soap bubbles floating in the night sky will take place. It cannot be viewed if the rooftop is closed due to bad weather.

## Limited-Edition Menu & Merchandise

At "Paradise Lounge" on the 46th floor, limited-edition drinks and sweets such as the "Sparkling Dome" (¥1,350) are available, and a winter-only mug (¥1,430) is sold at the SOUVENIR SHOP.

19.title: Ebisu Garden Place "Baccarat ETERNAL LIGHTS"
19.summary: "Baccarat ETERNAL LIGHTS," Ebisu's winter tradition featuring the illumination of one of the world's largest Baccarat chandeliers, will be held at Center Square, Ebisu Garden Place from November 14, 2026 to January 11, 2027. This year marks its 27th edition.
19.body:
The Baccarat chandelier display "**Baccarat ETERNAL LIGHTS**," a winter tradition at Ebisu Garden Place, returns again this year. Lighting up Ebisu every winter, it celebrates its 27th edition this year.

## One of the World's Largest Baccarat Chandeliers

The chandelier is among the largest in the world, standing about 5 m high and about 3 m wide, with a total of 8,500 crystal pieces and 250 lights. It was created by skilled artisans, including Meilleurs Ouvriers de France (M.O.F).

The aluminum showcase housing the chandelier (about 10 m high) has been renovated this year. Its main materials include recycled aluminum made by melting and casting the aluminum from the showcase used until last year.

- **Period**: Saturday, November 14, 2026 – Monday, January 11, 2027 (national holiday)

- **Lighting ceremony**: Saturday, November 14, 2026, from 17:00 (scheduled)
- **Venue**: Ebisu Garden Place Center Square (4-20 Ebisu, Shibuya-ku, Tokyo)

Around the same period, approximately 100,000 illumination lights and a Christmas market will also be held, adding color to winter strolls in Ebisu.

21.title: Tokyo Photographic Art Museum: "Duet: Asian Contemporary"
21.summary: "Duet: Asian Contemporary," an exhibition presenting contemporary Chinese and Japanese photography and video works, is on view at the Tokyo Photographic Art Museum in Ebisu through January 17, 2027.
21.body:
The exhibition "**Duet: Asian Contemporary**," presenting contemporary Chinese and Japanese photography and video works, is being held at the Tokyo Photographic Art Museum in Yebisu Garden Place.

## A Dialogue Exhibition of "Playing Together as Two"

Curation is supported by RongRong & inri, an internationally active photographer duo. Three Shadows Photography Art Centre, which the two founded in Beijing in 2007, has played an important role as a multi-purpose facility dedicated to photography.

A "duet" is originally a musical form played by two people. The exhibition overlays this idea, in which different voices and melodies respond to one another to form a single expression, onto the dialogue among the participating artists.

## Participating Artists

Toshiya Murakoshi / Wang Tuo / Sui Taka (Ta Ke) / Luo Yang / Jiang Pengyi / fumiko imano

## Exhibition Details

28.title: "Constella Lounge Shibuya Station by TKP" Opens in a Building at the Miyamasuzaka Intersection
28.summary: TKP is using the Kobayashi Building at the Miyamasuzaka intersection in Shibuya, which is awaiting redevelopment, as "TKP Shibuya Miyamasuzaka." "Constella Lounge Shibuya Station by TKP," which combines a coworking lounge and rental meeting rooms, opened on the 2nd floor on November 1, 2026.
28.body:
TKP Inc. has begun an initiative to make effective use of the period until redevelopment by leasing the Kobayashi Building at the Miyamasuzaka intersection in Shibuya-ku as a whole, from the 1st basement floor to the 5th floor, as "**TKP Shibuya Miyamasuzaka**."

## Making Use of the "Gap Period" Before Redevelopment

Due to factors such as rising construction costs, redevelopment schedules are being revised, and in some cases a building sits vacant between the departure of tenants and the start of construction. TKP is leasing the entire 483 tsubo as a single unit and, while existing tenants continue their operations, will run its group businesses in the vacant areas. The company's business originated in 2005 when it used vacant space in a building slated for demolition as rental meeting rooms, and this initiative is an extension of that approach.

## How Each Floor Will Be Used

- **2nd floor**: "Constella Lounge Shibuya Station by TKP" (opened November 1, 2026). A facility combining a coworking lounge and rental meeting rooms, a 1-minute walk from Shibuya Station
- **4th floor**: Under consideration for use as rental meeting rooms and an event space
- **5th floor**: Under consideration for use as a rental space in cooperation with the Spacemarket Group
- The 1st basement floor, 1st floor, and 3rd floor will continue to be operated by existing tenants

## Overview

- **Name**: TKP Shibuya Miyamasuzaka (Kobayashi Building)
- **Address**: 1-14-11 Shibuya, Shibuya-ku, Tokyo

37.title: Yin Yuan's New Performance "Umaku Iku" (Shibuya PARCO, PBOX STND)
37.summary: "Umaku Iku," a new performance by artist Yin Yuan, will be staged on Saturday, November 7, 2026 at PBOX STND on the 10th floor of Shibuya PARCO. Admission is free.
37.body:
Under the theme of "unconscious action and the passive body," **Yin Yuan** develops interdisciplinary work centered on performative installation. Now Yin Yuan presents a new performance, "Umaku Iku," at Shibuya PARCO.

## Questioning the Body Through the Image of the "Horse"

The work begins with the history of the horse: once a "force" that supported labor and war, it came to play a different role within the logic of machines and capital as society modernized. Taking the image of the "horse," which changes form yet is present everywhere in daily life, as a clue, the piece explores the body.

Yin Yuan was born in Shanghai, China, in 1993. After completing studies at the School of the Art Institute of Chicago, Yin Yuan came to Japan and completed the sculpture program at the Graduate School of Fine Arts, Tokyo University of the Arts. Yin Yuan is currently enrolled in the doctoral program at the same university.

## Event Details

- **Venue**: PBOX STND, 10F, Shibuya PARCO

38.title: Soundwalk Collective "What We Leave Behind / Jean-Luc Godard Archives" Screening (Shibuya PARCO)
38.summary: A screening and talk session of a work by Soundwalk Collective, which reconstructs Godard's personal archive through video and sound, will be held on Sunday, November 8, 2026 at PBOX STND, 10F, Shibuya PARCO. Admission is free.
38.body:
"What We Leave Behind / Jean-Luc Godard Archives" by **Soundwalk Collective**, an art unit based in New York and Berlin, will be screened at Shibuya PARCO.

## Reconstructing Godard's Archive

Soundwalk Collective is a unit formed by contemporary artist Stephan Crasneanscki and producer Simone Merli. They filmed and recorded sounds from film reels, notes, books and other personal archive materials of film director Jean-Luc Godard stored in his warehouse, and reconstructed them into original video and sound. Please note that the screened work is not a video work produced by Godard himself.

45.summary: A free photo exhibition featuring about 180 photos documenting Shibuya's cityscapes, along with oral histories, will be held on the 8th floor of Shibuya Hikarie from November 10 to 23.
45.body:
The "Shibuya Archive Photo Exhibition 2026," organized by Commons Archive Collective (CAC) with the support of Shibuya City, will be held at 8/COURT on the 8th floor of Shibuya Hikarie. This year's fourth edition has the theme "Streets and Voices" (Shibuya's Streets and Spoken Memories). Photos from the Shibuya City digital archive "SHIBUYA CITY RECORD" and the Shirane Memorial Shibuya Local History Museum & Literature Museum collection will also be provided.

## Highlights

- **Approx. 180 photos**: Scenes from the Taisho, Showa, and Heisei eras that can no longer be seen today, including Shibuya Station building in the late Taisho period and photos of Seibu Shibuya Store at the time of its opening (the store closed at the end of September 2026). A QR code on each photo lets you compare it with the present-day streetscape on Google Maps Street View.
- **Oral history**: Newly introduced this year. Listen to the stories of people who have lived, worked, and been active in Shibuya using the telephone receivers at the venue, and read them as Japanese and English text as well.
- **SHIBUYA TIMELINE**: A chronology tracing Shibuya's history from prehistoric times to the present. Partially updated this time to also introduce changes in urban infrastructure.

47.title: Information Session for FY2027 School Wellbeing Partner (SWP) Recruitment
47.summary: The Shibuya City Board of Education is announcing an information session for recruiting School Wellbeing Partners (SWP), fixed-term annual positions (kaikei nendo ninyō shokuin) for FY2027 (Reiwa 9).
47.body:
The Shibuya City Board of Education is announcing an information session for recruiting School Wellbeing Partners (SWP), fixed-term annual positions (kaikei nendo ninyō shokuin) for FY2027 (Reiwa 9).

## What is an SWP?

The SWP is a new psychological professional position in Shibuya City. SWPs provide consultation to students, parents/guardians, and teaching staff at their assigned schools, and work at ward-run elementary and junior high schools and the Education Center. In collaboration with schools, they work to prevent school non-attendance before it occurs and to support improved school life for students with developmental characteristics. Note that in FY2027 (Reiwa 9), SWPs are planned to be assigned to junior high schools only.

## Purpose of the Program

The program shifts measures against school non-attendance from the conventional "response after problems arise" to a "prevention and early detection" approach, and promotes "creating schools where children can consult with peace of mind."

## Who We Are Looking For

- People who can be close to students and build relationships of trust
- People who want to put their psychological expertise to use in schools
- People who understand the school environment and can provide support in collaboration with schools
- People who can work with teaching staff, parents/guardians, and related organizations to provide support as a team

Details are available in the information session flyer (PDF). For inquiries, contact the Education Counseling Section, Education Center (tel. 03-3463-3491).

48.title: Limited-Edition Autumn Festival Goshuin "Yoyogi no Mai" Now Available
48.summary: Meiji Jingu has been offering a limited-edition goshuin (shrine stamp) since November 1, featuring the kagura dance "Yoyogi no Mai" performed by shrine maidens at the autumn festival. Available as a pre-written sheet in limited quantities.
48.body:
Meiji Jingu began offering the "Autumn Grand Festival Limited Goshuin" on November 1, 2026. The goshuin is themed on the kagura dance "Yoyogi no Mai," performed by shrine maidens at autumn festivals, including the annual festival on November 3, the birthday of Emperor Meiji.

Quantities are limited. Please note that the goshuin is provided as a pre-written sheet.

## What Is "Yoyogi no Mai"?

"Yoyogi no Mai" is a kagura dance unique to Meiji Jingu. Its lyrics are taken from a waka poem composed by Emperor Meiji, and it was created in 1968 (Showa 43) to commemorate the 100th anniversary of the Meiji Restoration.

> Isonokami furuki tameshi o tazunetsutsu atarashiki yo no koto mo sadamemu (Poem by Emperor Meiji)

## Highlights

The shrine maidens, dressed in splendid costumes, dance with sleeves fluttering in a strikingly beautiful performance that soothes the spirit of the enshrined deities and adds splendor to the Autumn Grand Festival. The lavish costume includes a chrysanthemum-shaped crown (tenkan), a ho robe blue-printed with paulownia, bamboo and phoenix designs, a hanpi vest embroidered with paulownia and phoenix, and a pale warbler-green shitagasane underrobe.

Please take one home as a memento of your autumn visit.

73.title: SHIBUYA QWS Signs Partnership Agreements with Startup Support Hubs in Australia and South Korea
73.summary: SHIBUYA QWS, the co-creation facility on the 15th floor of Shibuya Scramble Square, has signed facility partnership agreements with Y.hub in Australia and with GSC, SVC Seoul and dcamp in South Korea. The agreements expand its support network in Oceania and Asia to help its members expand overseas.
73.body:
SHIBUYA QWS (pronounced "Shibuya Queues"), a co-creation facility on the 15th floor of Shibuya Scramble Square, has signed facility partnership agreements with several overseas hubs to strengthen its startup support network in Australia and South Korea.

## Overview of the Agreements

- July 7, 2026: **Y.hub** in Yanchep, Australia
- October 23, 2026: **Global Startup Center (GSC)** and **Startup Venture Campus Seoul (SVC Seoul)** in Seoul, South Korea
- October 26, 2026: **dcamp** in Seoul, South Korea

## Main Areas of Cooperation

- Mutual introductions of companies and others that contribute to the Japan-Korea and Japan-Australia startup communities
- Mutual use of each facility by supported or member startups and large companies, as well as operating staff
- Support for building international networks through jointly hosted events and programs

## About the Hubs

Y.hub is an innovation community hub in Yanchep, Western Australia, offering coworking space and support for entrepreneurs. GSC and SVC Seoul are hubs that support foreign entrepreneurs and overseas startups entering the South Korean market. dcamp is a support organization run by a foundation jointly established by 19 South Korean financial institutions, providing investment, acceleration, mentoring and more.

QWS has previously signed agreements with facilities in South Korea, Singapore and Finland. It will continue to expand its partnerships with overseas hubs to support its members' global expansion and the entry of overseas startups into Japan.

74.body:

Until the final day of business, you can enjoy the experience as usual, and reservations are being accepted. You can make watches, bracelets with Italian charms, the popular keyboard keychains and more by choosing from a wide range of parts and combining colors and motifs.

After the closure, you can enjoy the experience at the following stores.

- **Love Lab Harajuku** (Room 1, 2F Noguchi Building, 1-21-12 Jingumae, Shibuya-ku, Tokyo): Keyboard keychains, Italian charms and more. No reservation required; first come, first served
- **Love Lab Yokohama Chinatown** (Yokohama Bazaar 102A, 166 Yamashita-cho, Naka-ku, Yokohama): No reservation required; first come, first served
- **Daikanyama sister shop BROWNY** (2F Section A, 10-10 Daikanyama-cho, Shibuya-ku, Tokyo): Glitter art experience. No reservation required; first come, first served

76.body:
The Entrepreneurship Center at Aoyama Gakuin University will hold the final judging of the "Aoyama Business Plan Contest 2026" on Saturday, November 28, 2026, at the Aoyama Campus, McCaleb Memorial Hall.

This contest is an entrepreneur support event aimed at fostering entrepreneurship among Aoyama Gakuin students, from high school students to graduate students. This year there were 34 applications, and the 5 teams that passed the first-round document screening will present their business plans in front of the judges.

## Highlights

- **Grand Prize**: 500,000 yen in startup support funds, provided by Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Club Co., Ltd.
- **Excellence Award**: A pair of round-trip tickets to Canada, provided by Air Canada
- **Sponsor Awards**: Prize money and prizes from sponsoring companies

The chief judge is Fumio Takahashi (Chairman of the Naganuma School educational corporation and Professor Emeritus at Aoyama Gakuin University). Seiji Iwaguma, Mika Kumahira, Yukiko Kato, and others will serve as judges. Mentoring support from alumni was also provided to those who passed the document screening.

This contest continues an initiative that has run since 2019, and is being held in a renewed form by the Entrepreneurship Center, which was established in April 2026. Admission is free, but advance registration is required, and attendance is open to university students, related parties, and members of the press.

77.title: HARVEST Ebisu Store Reopens After Renovation
77.summary: The Ebisu store of tableware brand HARVEST will reopen on November 12, 2026, with its sales floor expanded to about 1.5 times its current size.
77.body:
"THE HARVEST KITCHEN GENERAL STORE" (HARVEST Ebisu Store), which focuses on tableware and kitchen tools, will reopen after renovation on Thursday, November 12, 2026. About 12 years after its opening in October 2014, this is an update of the store for the next decade.

## Sales Floor Expanded from About 20 Tsubo to About 30 Tsubo

By adding the space adjacent to the existing store, the sales floor area becomes about 1.5 times the previous size. The walls that used to divide the interior have been removed, and the register counter has been relocated. By creating an open feel in the space, the layout now allows visitors to wander freely around the store. The lively atmosphere that is typical of HARVEST, with products packed closely together, will remain as it is.

## A New Event Space Is Born

The adjacent restaurant space has been remodeled to create a new project-style space that will serve as "another HARVEST." Plans include holding pop-up shops by artists and brands, themed fairs tailored to seasons and occasions, and events.

## The Garden Area Evolves Too

A new roof will be installed over the Garden area that continues from the YARD SALE corner. This makes it less affected by the weather, and a wooden deck will be laid underfoot to eliminate level differences.

82.title: Knife brand "FE" Opens New Store on Takeshita Street
82.summary: Japanese knife brand "FE" has opened a new store on Takeshita Street in Harajuku, in collaboration with Genelly. The store features a futuristic space where kitchen knives and fashion meet.
82.body:
"FE," a new knife brand from TAIMATSU Co., Ltd., which operates the Japanese knife brand "MUSASHI JAPAN," has opened a new store on Takeshita Street in Harajuku in collaboration with Genelly Co., Ltd. The project came together after about a year and a half of exchanges and discussions that began around spring 2025.

## A Futuristic Store Space

The interior is a stark, silver-toned space combined with red linear lighting. Metallic wall surfaces, curved displays, and geometric display stands express FE's cutting-edge worldview. In the center of the store is a display area where you can view the knives up close and enjoy every detail, from the texture of the blades to the design of the handles.

## Selling the "ZAKU" Meteorite Series

The store mainly sells the "ZAKU" meteorite series, created as FE's first release. It is characterized by the contrast between a rough, rugged texture inspired by meteorites and a polished blade edge. Following the Osaka and Kyoto stores, you can now also see and hold the actual products at the Harajuku store.

## Genelly's Brand Also on Offer

In addition to FE knives, the store also sells products from "LAZYSLAY," a fashion brand operated by Genelly. By blending two different fields, knives and fashion, into a single space, the store aims to share the appeal of Japanese craftsmanship, even with people who have had little opportunity to handle knives before.

85.title: Saga's Ebisu Statue Unveiling Ceremony and the "EBISU SUPER HAPPY" Mural
85.summary: An Ebisu statue about 100 years old traveled from Saga City via Nishinomiya Shrine to arrive in Ebisu, and was unveiled on October 31 together with the mural "EBISU SUPER HAPPY." It is enshrined at "Art, Tea & Bar homunculus."
85.body:
An approximately 100-year-old Ebisu statue from Saga City, which boasts the most Ebisu statues in Japan (over 830), has arrived in Ebisu, Tokyo, and an unveiling ceremony was held on Saturday, October 31, 2026.

## Arriving in Ebisu After a Long Journey

The Ebisu statue left the "Kaiun Saga Ebisu Station" on September 28. It had a safety prayer held at Chinzei Nishinomiya Shrine in Kawasoe-cho, Saga City, then passed through Nishinomiya Shrine in Hyogo Prefecture, the head shrine of Ebisu worship, before being enshrined in Ebisu. The statue is placed in the space in front of "Art, Tea & Bar homunculus," which is also a Saga City specialty products partner store.

## A Mural Painted with Children

The shutter of the shop now features a colorful mural, "EBISU SUPER HAPPY," by artist Kensuke Miyazaki. During production, workshops were held with local elementary school students and children connected to embassies in Shibuya City. This initiative is part of Shibuya City's anti-graffiti program, the "Shibuya Arrow Project."

## A "Lucky Spot" Connecting Saga and Tokyo

At "Art, Tea & Bar homunculus," you can enjoy Saga's specialty products and fine sake, and it also serves as a base for sharing the appeal of Saga's Ebisu culture and walking around the town. Ebisu, the birthplace of Yebisu Beer, and Saga City are connected through the bond of "Ebisu," and the circle of exchange will continue to grow.

The unveiling ceremony included the unveiling of the completed mural and behind-the-scenes stories of its creation, the unveiling of the Ebisu statue, an introduction to Saga's Ebisu culture and history by the "Ebisu DE Machizukuri Network," and a commemorative photo session.

86.title: manana suerte × MAISON GATE POPUP STORE

87.body:

"Sugi no Ko" is the second location of a karaoke snack bar near Shibuya Station.

## Co-Creation Events with Companies

Experiences to be enjoyed across the entire alley are also planned, including collaborations with brands and products, seasonal events, and programs linking multiple venues. The fun of hopping from one venue to another is also part of the appeal.

By making use of land for temporary use until redevelopment begins, the project aims to revitalize Shibuya's nighttime economy. Payment will be cashless only, and details such as business hours and prices will be announced on the official website as they become available.

89.body:
The interactive event "Apple Picking, Maybe Exhibition 2026" (Ringo-gari Kamoshirenai Ten 2026) will be held from November 14 at the gallery space "Hobo Nichi Sunday" on the 8th floor of Shibuya PARCO. It is organized by "Hobonichi." Held every year around this time since 2021, the event is inspired by "Ringo Kamoshirenai" (It Might Be an Apple), a popular picture book by author Shinsuke Yoshitake.

A large tree sculpture serving as the symbol of the event is set up in the center of the gallery, where visitors can enjoy an indoor "apple picking (maybe)."

## Highlights

- **Over 50 varieties of apples**: Apples from "Sun Farm," a farm in Morioka City, Iwate Prefecture, run for about 300 years across 11 generations, arrive in several batches during the event, including rare varieties. Each comes with a variety-name sticker, so you can compare sweetness, tartness, and flesh firmness to make your choice (from 300 yen each).

Approximately 500,000 blue lights combined with projected visuals create a dazzling winter scene in Shibuya. 97.title: Shibuya Ward to Install Around 50 Locations with About 250 "Smart Trash Bins," Aiming for Completion Within the Fiscal Year
97.summary: Shibuya Ward plans to install about 250 "smart trash bins" at around 50 locations near Shibuya Station within this fiscal year. The bins can report the amount of trash remotely, run on solar power, and compact trash automatically.
97.body:
Tokyo's Shibuya Ward has announced plans to install about 250 "smart trash bins" at around 50 locations near Shibuya Station within this fiscal year.

## Features of the Smart Trash Bins

- The amount of trash discarded can be monitored remotely
- Powered by solar energy
- Automatically compacts trash to one-fifth of its volume

## Budget and Background

The ward expects a budget of about 500 million yen, including installation and collection costs, and plans to use a subsidy of about 350 million yen from the Tokyo Metropolitan Government. In recent years, the number of visitors from Japan and overseas around Shibuya Station has surged, and the increase in trash littered on the streets had become a problem.

## Strengthened Measures

Since June this year, the ward has imposed a 2,000 yen fine on people who litter, and it has also strengthened countermeasures, such as requiring restaurants and other businesses in busy entertainment districts to provide trash bins. After the smart trash bins are installed, the ward plans to manage them, including patrolling the bins 24 hours a day, 365 days a year.
