Details on the items are available on the store news page.

108.title: Hitotsubu Kanro's "Gummitzel Mascot 3" Now on Sale
108.summary: The capsule toy "Gummitzel Mascot 3" is now on sale at Hitotsubu Kanro in Harakado.
108.body:
"Hitotsubu Kanro's Gummitzel Mascot 3" is now on sale at "Hitotsubu Kanro" in Harakado.

This is the third installment of the mascot series themed on the popular Gummitzel.

Details can be found on the store news page.

109.title: Soup Stock Tokyo's New Concept Restaurant "Akino Table" Opens at Shibuya Stream
109.summary: Soup Stock Tokyo's new concept restaurant "Akino Table" will open inside Shibuya Stream on December 1, 2026. Enjoy dishes made with seasonal ingredients from daytime through the evening.
109.body:
Soup Stock Tokyo will open its new concept restaurant "Akino Table" inside Shibuya Stream on Tuesday, December 1, 2026. The restaurant aims to be a place to eat where you can return to yourself amid a busy daily life.

## Restaurant Concept

Although the seating is at a counter, the table is designed to feel as warm as sitting around a dining table with others. The height and the look of the chairs differ from seat to seat, so each guest can spend their time in their own way. It suits quiet time alone, an evening out with someone special, or a moment enjoying drinks and conversation with people you've just met.

## Seasonal Ingredients on One Plate

Drawing on connections with producers across Japan built through making soup, the restaurant expresses the strength and character of seasonal ingredients in a single dish. The menu changes with the seasons and available ingredients.

## From Daytime to Night

The menu offers dishes suited to every time of day: a hearty lunch, an afternoon break with something sweet, a relaxed evening, and a light bite late at night.

## Store Information

- Address: 3-21-3 Shibuya, Shibuya-ku, Tokyo (inside Shibuya Stream)
- Hours: 11:00–23:00 (last order for food 22:00, drinks 22:30)
- Closed: Follows Shibuya Stream's regular holidays
- Phone: 03-6427-6055

## Reservations

Reservations are being accepted online only (no phone reservations) from Wednesday, November 4, 2026. From Tuesday, December 1 to Sunday, December 6, the restaurant is reservation-only. From Monday, December 7, walk-ins are also welcome.

110.title: Christmas Gut Health Wine Party
110.summary: KIREIdesign will hold a "Christmas Gut Health Wine Party" on Saturday, December 19, 2026 at FELLOWS Bistro & Bar in Ebisu. Enjoy a gut health seminar, a special course meal with wine, and a live music performance.
110.body:
Yokohama-based KIREIdesign will hold a "Christmas Gut Health Wine Party" on Saturday, December 19, 2026 at "FELLOWS Bistro & Bar" in Ebisu. It is the second installment of the Christmas special event series, following the first event held in September.

## Highlights

- **Gut health seminar**: An easy-to-understand introduction to the relationship between gut environment and health, and points to keep in mind in your daily diet and lifestyle habits.
- **Special course meal and wine**: Enjoy a course meal made with ingredients chosen with gut health in mind, paired with wines matched to each dish.
- **Magic show & live music**: "dear" (HIRO & TATSUKI), a music unit from Shonan, will present an interactive magic show and a live performance of original songs.
- **Meeting other participants**: There will also be time for participants to chat naturally, sparked by the food and music.

## Event Details

The event runs from 13:00 to 15:30 at 3F Daini Tomoe Building, 1-9-1 Ebisunishi, Shibuya-ku, Tokyo. The participation fee is 9,800 yen (tax included), and the capacity is 37 people. Applications are accepted via the official LINE account (@330dswst).

111.title: Thai Bedroom Pop Artist pami to Hold First Japan Solo Show "pami Live in Tokyo"
111.summary: Thai singer-songwriter pami will hold her first solo concert in Japan at Veats Shibuya on February 13, 2027. The official presale opens at 12:00 on November 6.
111.body:
Singer-songwriter "pami" from Phuket, Thailand, will hold her solo concert "pami Live in Tokyo" on Saturday, February 13, 2027, at Veats Shibuya in Udagawacho, Shibuya. It will be her first solo concert in Japan.

## About pami

Her music is characterized by a transparent singing voice and a sound centered on bedroom pop and indie pop, incorporating elements of lo-fi, jazz, and R&B. She expresses delicate emotions born from love and everyday life in English lyrics. She released her first album "puffette" in 2025, and is also set to perform at the Hong Kong music festival "Clockenflap 2026."

In Japan, she has also performed at the music events "BiKN shibuya" (2025) and "THAI ON FESTIVAL 2026," and has spoken of being influenced by Japanese music such as Hikaru Utada, YUI, Akina Nakamori, and city pop.

## Event Details

- Date: Saturday, February 13, 2027
- Time: Doors open 17:30 / Show starts 18:00
- Venue: Veats Shibuya (33-1 Udagawacho, Shibuya-ku, Tokyo)
- Price: Standing general admission ¥9,800, VIP ¥19,800 (tax included, plus a separate ¥600 drink charge)

VIP tickets include perks such as a one-on-one meet & greet with the artist, photo opportunity, and VIP-exclusive merchandise. The official presale runs from 12:00 on Friday, November 6 to 23:59 on Wednesday, November 11, and general sales begin at 10:00 on Saturday, December 5. Children under school age are not admitted.

112.title: GO TODAY SHAiRE SALON Acquires Shared Salon "SALON VILLAGE OMOTESANDO," Now "MAiSON Omotesando"
112.summary: GO TODAY SHAiRE SALON Co., Ltd. has taken over the shared salon "SALON VILLAGE OMOTESANDO," formerly operated by AHL Co., Ltd., and has been running it since September 1, 2026 as its own brand, "MAiSON Omotesando." It also acquired one salon in Ginza at the same time.
112.body:
GO TODAY SHAiRE SALON Co., Ltd., headquartered in Shibuya-ku, has acquired the businesses of the shared salons "SALON VILLAGE OMOTESANDO (Omotesando)" and "SALON VILLAGE due. (Ginza)," formerly operated by AHL Co., Ltd. Operations began on September 1, 2026, and the announcement was made on November 5.

## A Fresh Start as "MAiSON Omotesando"

The Omotesando salon will be operated as "MAiSON Omotesando," a directly managed store of GO TODAY's private-room, exclusive-use in-house brand "MAiSON." It is located at B1F Prefas Omotesando, 4-11-6 Jingumae, Shibuya-ku, Tokyo. Under the previous operator, the salon opened in July 2022.

## Background to the Acquisition

- **Inheriting prime-location sites**: With Ginza and Omotesando, two of central Tokyo's most prestigious locations, the company will strengthen its urban expansion under "MAiSON."
- **Maintaining the environment for current crew**: The company will ensure that the stylists (crew) on staff can keep working at the salons they know well, and will further improve their working environment.
- **Accelerating growth through M&A**: The company positions acquiring high-quality salon businesses as a pillar of its growth strategy and intends to continue actively pursuing this.

Tsuruta Masaji, CEO of AHL, commented that he judged entrusting the salons to a company that has specialized in operating shared salons to be the best path for the crew to remain active with peace of mind over the long term. Ohba Kunihiko, CEO of GO TODAY, stated that the company will first protect an environment where the current crew can work with peace of mind, and then use its operational expertise to make the salons even more satisfying.

114.title: Kärcher Creates Cleaning Art Message Board at Hands Shibuya Ahead of Its Closing
114.summary: On November 4, German cleaning equipment maker Kärcher held "Sen-Kyu! Hands," a message-board event using cleaning art, at the Hands Shibuya store, which will close on the 15th.
114.body:
On November 4, German cleaning equipment maker Kärcher held "Sen-Kyu! Hands," a message-board event using "cleaning art," at the Hands Shibuya store (Udagawacho, Shibuya-ku), which will close on the 15th of this month. The event was organized by Kärcher Japan, the company's Japanese subsidiary.

## Part of the Senden Project

The event is part of the "Kärcher Senden Project," which the company has been running since April. It is an initiative that lets people casually enjoy "reverse graffiti" in the city, drawing pictures through the contrast between areas where dirt has been washed away with a pressure washer and areas left untouched. Shibuya is the fourth city in the project, and the event was held as one of the "We're Washing Shibuya" actions.

## Messages from Six Shibuya Locations

On a wall of SING Street, between Hands Shibuya and Shibuya Parco, messages from six locations were drawn: Shibuya Loft, Tower Records Shibuya, SHIBUYA109 Shibuya, Shibuya Parco, Seibu Shibuya, and the Hachiko statue. Using a commercial-grade high-pressure washer and stencils, dirt was removed along the shapes of the messages to make them appear.

## Citizen Message-Writing Experience on the Rooftop

On the rooftop, which was once open to the public, a citizen-participation message-writing experience was also held, mainly for Hands members. Stencils of messages such as "Thank you" and hand illustrations were prepared. One woman who took part said, "I hope I can leave behind some memories," expressing her regret over the closing.

## Other Cleaning Actions

On November 1, Hachiko's footprints were drawn leading from the Hachiko statue to the Hachiko statue in Miyashita Park. On November 2 and 3, as a collaboration with the "Shibuya Art Festival," artist BAKIBAKI created artwork on a wall along the Shibuya River.

115.title: Tokyu to Open "AXSH Conference" Rental Meeting Rooms at SHIBUYA AXSH in March 2027
115.summary: Tokyu will open the multipurpose rental meeting room "AXSH Conference" on the 4th floor of SHIBUYA AXSH on March 1, 2027. Reservations opened on November 5, 2026.
115.body:
Tokyu will open "AXSH Conference," a multipurpose rental meeting room, on the 4th floor of SHIBUYA AXSH, a large mixed-use complex in the Shibuya Station east exit area, on **Monday, March 1, 2027**. Reservations have been available since 12:00 on Thursday, November 5, 2026 (planned).

SHIBUYA AXSH opened in July 2024 as a hub that enhances walkability in the "Aoshibu" area connecting the Aoyama direction and the Shibuya Station area. AXSH Conference is one of its core facilities, aiming to be a "stage for dialogue and exchange" where diverse businesspeople and creators meet.

## Features

- An open space filled with natural light, with 4-meter-high ceilings and large windows (Room 01, 02, 03)
- Movable partitions allow the layout to be changed, accommodating up to 111 people
- Advanced audio and video equipment for high-level presentations, plus Wi-Fi and wired network connections
- A smart user environment with no face-to-face procedures required, from reservation through entry and exit

The space supports a wide range of uses, including strategy meetings, press conferences for new products, seminars, exhibitions, and receptions. It is also conveniently located a 1-minute walk from Shibuya Station, with access that keeps you out of the rain.

## Opening Campaign

Use from March 1 to August 31, 2027 will receive a **20% discount** off regular rates. Address: 2-17-1 Shibuya, Shibuya-ku, Tokyo.

116.title: "CAFÉ LATORY ROOM": Experiential Event Celebrating the 10th Anniversary of Blendy Café Latory
116.summary: Ajinomoto AGF will hold an experiential event celebrating the 10th anniversary of the "Blendy Café Latory" Stick at HOTEL EMANON in Shibuya for four days only, from November 19 to 22. Admission is free, with advance reservations required.
116.body:
Ajinomoto AGF will hold an experiential event, "A Little Happiness for You: CAFÉ LATORY ROOM," celebrating the 10th anniversary of the "Blendy® Café Latory®" Stick. It will run for four days, from Thursday, November 19 to Sunday, November 22, 2026, at "HOTEL EMANON" in Nanpeidai-cho, Shibuya-ku.

This is the 4th edition of the event, which has welcomed more than 6,000 visitors in total so far. For the 10th anniversary, visitors can walk through the venue and experience how a cup they choose themselves feels even more special than usual.

## Highlights

- **Guided by the manager**: Guided by the "Café Latory Room Manager," you will receive the 10th anniversary "CAFÉ LATORY ROOM -No.17- Story Book."
- **Choose your cup from all 17 flavors**: Choose a cup from a menu of 17 varieties to suit your taste or mood of the day. Original venue-exclusive pairing sweets can also be enjoyed.
- **A special room for visitors only**: After the experience, you will be guided to "CAFÉ LATORY ROOM -No.17-," which only visitors can enter, where venue-exclusive content is also available.

## Event Details

Hours are 10:00–18:40 (last entry 17:40). Participation is free but requires an advance reservation (first come, first served, limited to 20 people per session). Some same-day reservation slots are also available, with reservations accepted from 8:00 a.m. on the day. The experience takes about 60 minutes from check-in. The venue is a 9-minute walk from the New South Exit of JR Shibuya Station.

117.title: Baymax N.E.W. Movie POP-UP STORE
117.summary: A POP-UP STORE commemorating the vinyl release of the original soundtrack for the movie "Baymax N.E.W. ○○" will be held at UNIVERSAL MUSIC STORE HARAJUKU in Harajuku from November 18 to 29.
117.body:
A POP-UP STORE commemorating the vinyl release of the original soundtrack for the movie "Baymax N.E.W." will be held at "UNIVERSAL MUSIC STORE HARAJUKU" in Harajuku.

## Highlights

In addition to original movie merchandise produced by Universal Music, the store will carry apparel items such as T-shirts. A large lineup of newly designed goods based on "Kakugai-kun" and "Seven Bear," among others, is also planned.

In addition to CDs and vinyl records, the store plans to display scene photos from the movie and set up photo spots.

## Event Details

- **Location**: UNIVERSAL MUSIC STORE HARAJUKU, 1F & 3F
- **Dates**: Wednesday, November 18 – Sunday, November 29, 2026
- **Hours**: 11:00–20:00
- **Address**: 1-20-6 Jingumae, Shibuya-ku, Tokyo (3-minute walk from Harajuku Station on the JR Yamanote Line)

Reservations for entry to the POP-UP STORE are scheduled to open at 18:00 on Thursday, November 5. Details such as eligible dates and how to apply will be announced on the event's official website.

The vinyl record will be released on November 18. It is a 2-LP set priced at 5,500 yen (tax included) and contains 30 tracks in total.

118.title: Nissui "GYONIPO" Free Sample Event
118.summary: Nissui is offering a limited quantity of "GYONIPO," a new-style fish snack made with fish sausage, free of charge on the rooftop terrace of Tokyu Plaza Harajuku "Harakado" through November 8.
118.body:
Nissui Corporation is holding a limited-time event from Thursday, November 5 to Sunday, November 8, 2026 (4 days) on the rooftop terrace on the 6th and 7th floors of Tokyu Plaza Harajuku "Harakado." It will give away, in limited quantities, "GYONIPO," a new-style fish snack that looks like french fries but is actually made from fish sausage.

## An Initiative for Younger Generations Eating Less Fish

The event is timed to coincide with "Ii Sakana no Hi" (Good Fish Day, November 3–7), designated by Japan's Fisheries Agency, and aims to help younger people enjoy fish casually. Annual per-person consumption of edible fish and seafood in Japan has nearly halved, from 40.2 kg in fiscal 2001 to 21.3 kg in fiscal 2024.

## About GYONIPO

"GYONIPO" is a snack made by cutting about one stick of "Osakana no Sausage" (fish sausage) into long, thin strips, coating them lightly in batter, and frying them. It has a "crispy-crunchy texture" that is crisp on the outside and light on the inside, and the more you chew, the more the savory flavor of the fish sausage and a pleasant saltiness spread. Because you can pick it up with one hand, it can be enjoyed as a snack rather than as a fish dish. It was also developed with an emphasis on being easy to make at home.

## Interactive Activity and Novelties

In addition to photo spots, the venue features "OSAKANA WALL," an interactive activity where visitors can suggest new ways to eat fish. Post an idea and you will receive an "Osakana no Sausage." Follow Nissui's official Instagram account and you will also receive an original "GYONIPO" drawstring pouch.

- Hours: 12:00–18:00 (November 5 only: 14:00–18:00)
- Admission: Free (limited quantity each day, while supplies last)
- Entry may be restricted depending on crowd conditions

119.title: New Balance Harajuku 10th Anniversary Festival
119.summary: To celebrate the 10th anniversary of New Balance Harajuku's opening, the "10th Anniversary Festival" will be held from November 5 to December 7, 2026. Limited-edition items, services and exhibits will be rolled out in stages under four themes.
119.body:
New Balance Japan will hold the "10th Anniversary Festival" for about one month, from Thursday, November 5 to Monday, December 7, 2026, to celebrate the 10th anniversary of the opening of New Balance Harajuku in Harajuku, Tokyo.

During the period, a variety of content, including limited-edition items, services and exhibits, will be rolled out in stages around four themes: "Fitting," "Style," "Care" and "Craftsmanship."

## Part 1: "Fitting"

The theme is "fit," which New Balance has pursued since its founding. Try-ons of the featured shoe, the "Made in USA 990v7," are scheduled from October 23 to December 7. Sizes from 23.0 to 29.0 cm are available (22.5 cm and 30.0 cm are not offered), and any visitor to the store can try them.

With a 3D scan, foot length, width, instep height, arch height and more are measured, and staff suggest shoes that suit your purpose. Fitting consultations with staff who hold shoe fitter qualifications are also available.

## Upcoming Schedule

- From Friday, November 13: Part 2 "Style"
- From Friday, November 27: Part 3 "Care"
- From Friday, December 4: Part 4 "Craftsmanship"

## Other Events

With any purchase during the period, you will receive one 10th anniversary sticker per transaction (while supplies last). On the 4th-floor Made floor, shoes favored by myNB members, sponsored athletes and Harajuku store staff will be on special display, and a photo area will also be set up inside the elevator.

120.title: Ishinomaki Laboratory New Collection Exhibition "Moving Forward"
120.summary: Ishinomaki Laboratory's new collection exhibition "Moving Forward" is on through November 15 at the cafe dotcom space Tokyo in Harajuku. Admission is free.
120.body:
Ishinomaki Laboratory's new collection exhibition "Moving Forward" is being held at the cafe dotcom space Tokyo in Harajuku, Tokyo. The exhibition runs from Saturday, October 17, 2026 to Sunday, November 15, 2026.

dotcom space Tokyo is a community space that combines specialty coffee, design, and technology. It was designed by Keiji Ashizawa Design and opened in 2019.

## Exhibition Highlights

New products created in collaboration with three overseas-based design studios and designers (BIG-GAME, TAF Studio, and Daniel Schofield) are displayed alongside representative furniture from Ishinomaki Laboratory, founded in 2011, in a layout by stylist Yumi Nakata.

- **BOX STOOL** (BIG-GAME)
- **STUDIO TROLLEY** (TAF Studio)
- **RA BIRD** (Daniel Schofield)

Karimoku Furniture was involved in manufacturing the new products, which use GLT (Gathered Laminated Timber) made by making full use of hardwood from Japan's satoyama woodlands. BOX STOOL and STUDIO TROLLEY can be disassembled for compact packing and transport, carrying on the DIY spirit that Ishinomaki Laboratory has long cherished.

During the exhibition, collaboration menu items are also available at the cafe. Admission is free, and opening hours are 10:00–18:30.

121.title: Able Carry “Carry the Future” POP-UP
121.summary: Hong Kong-born backpack brand ABLE CARRY will hold a pop-up gathering its entire lineup available in Japan on November 21 and 22 at WITH HARAJUKU LIFORK. Unreleased new items will be previewed, and venue-exclusive models will be on sale.
121.body:
Highmount, the official Japanese distributor of the Hong Kong-born backpack brand "ABLE CARRY," will hold the pop-up event "Able Carry “Carry the Future” POP-UP" at WITH HARAJUKU LIFORK in Harajuku.

## Event Details

- **Date & Time**: Saturday, November 21 and Sunday, November 22, 2026, 10:30-17:00
- **Venue**: WITH HARAJUKU LIFORK (WITH HARAJUKU 3F, 1-14-30 Jingumae, Shibuya-ku, Tokyo)
- **Admission**: Free, no advance reservation required

Entry restrictions or waiting times may occur depending on how crowded the venue is.

## Highlights

All Able Carry products available in Japan will be gathered for display and sale. Part of the latest models scheduled for release in December can be purchased ahead of their release.

Also on sale in limited quantities is the event-exclusive venue-only model "Core Sling Denim" (Black/Blue, 19,800 yen including tax). It features a denim material with a laminate finish for enhanced water resistance and durability.

Everyone who purchases a backpack will receive a customized bag handle as a gift. An embroidery service is also available for those who wish (limited quantity, first come, first served). In addition, special edition collaboration products will be on display, and a special coffee stand by KOFFEE MAMEYA will be set up.

122.title: Ringo Jam Café (Mrs. GREEN APPLE Fan Club 10th Anniversary Theme Café)
122.summary: A theme café celebrating the 10th anniversary of Mrs. GREEN APPLE's official fan club "Ringo Jam" is on now at BOX cafe&space GEMS Shibuya through December 6, 2026.
122.body:
"Ringo Jam Café," a theme café celebrating the 10th anniversary of Mrs. GREEN APPLE's official fan club "Ringo Jam," is being held at BOX cafe&space GEMS Shibuya in Shibuya.

Featuring the fan club's official mascot character "Memeru" as the main visual, the café incorporates elements of the official app "MGA App" into its menu and interior.

## Menu Highlights

- Ringo Jam 10th Anniversary Pancakes (¥1,390, tax included)
- Soda with a syrup flavor and fruit topping chosen by each member (¥1,190, tax included)
- Waku Waku! JAM'S Draw Sandwich Plate (¥1,590, tax included)
- Hyokkori Memeru Parfait (¥1,290, tax included)

## Bonuses and Merchandise

**As an exclusive bonus for guests with advance reservations**, guests who make a reservation (¥550 per person, tax included, deducted from the food and drink bill at checkout) and order food or drinks will receive a JAM'S Draw message card with a handwritten message from the members (3 random designs). In addition, for every eligible drink ordered, guests will receive a coaster (2 random designs).

Original merchandise will also be available, including Memeru key charms, sticker sets, and acrylic stand coasters. The café will also be held in Ikebukuro and Shinjuku in turn, and food trucks are planned at tour venues and commercial facilities.

123.title: Fanatics MLB POP-UP STORE (Tokyu Plaza Omotesando "Omokado")
123.summary: Fanatics Japan held an official MLB pop-up store at Tokyu Plaza Omotesando "Omokado" from October 24 to November 2, 2026.
123.body:
Fanatics Japan LLC opened a limited-time pop-up store, "Fanatics MLB POP-UP STORE," for the official MLB online shop at Tokyu Plaza Omotesando "Omokado."

## Over 300 Items Including Merchandise of Shohei Ohtani and More

The venue featured merchandise of Shohei Ohtani, Yoshinobu Yamamoto, and Munetaka Murakami. Jerseys and name & number T-shirts of Pete Crow-Armstrong and Jacob Misiorowski, who made breakthroughs this season, were also available.

A total of more than 300 items were on display, including the popular "Under Wraps" series and rare autographed balls. A large screen in the store showed exciting MLB game footage, creating a space where shoppers could enjoy the excitement of the games while shopping.

## World Series Commemorative Merchandise

In the 2026 MLB Postseason, the Milwaukee Brewers, who advanced to the World Series for the first time in 44 years, faced the Tampa Bay Rays, who won the American League for the first time in 6 years. Commemorative matchup T-shirts, league championship locker room T-shirts, official balls, pennants, decals, and more were prominently displayed.

T-shirts commemorating key players' appearances were also available, and these commemorative items are also sold at the official MLB online shop.

124.title: Tabelog Magazine Features Carnitas Specialty Shop in Dogenzaka Serving Buzzworthy "Jiro-style" Tacos
124.summary: Tabelog Magazine's series "Delicious Restaurants Rated 3.5 or Below on Tabelog" featured a carnitas specialty shop in Dogenzaka, Shibuya. The tacos are described as "Jiro-style" tacos with an addictive mix of pork flavors.
124.body:
Tabelog Magazine's series "Delicious Restaurants Rated 3.5 or Below on Tabelog" featured a carnitas specialty shop in Dogenzaka, Shibuya, known for its much-talked-about "Jiro-style" tacos.

This series asks food lovers to recommend delicious restaurants rated 3.5 or below on Tabelog.

This time, the guide is Koichiro Yoshikawa, a taco navigator and tortilla researcher. He introduces a carnitas specialty shop in Shibuya.

The article presents the shop's tacos as an addictive dish, not a bowl but a plate, with a mix of pork flavors.

Carnitas is a Mexican pork dish. It is also a popular taco filling.

For the shop name and further details, please check the Tabelog Magazine article.

shibuya-parco.name: Shibuya PARCO
shibuya-parco.description: A hub for fashion and culture located on Koen-dori Street. Art, music, and pop-up events are held daily at PARCO MUSEUM TOKYO, PBOX STND, the POP UP space, and more.

miyashita-park.name: MIYASHITA PARK
miyashita-park.description: A complex combining a commercial facility and a hotel, with Shibuya Ward's Miyashita Park on the rooftop. Food and culture events are held on the rooftop lawn plaza, and pop-up events are held inside the building.

shibuya-sky.name: SHIBUYA SKY (Shibuya Scramble Square)
shibuya-sky.description: An observation facility at the very top of Shibuya Scramble Square, about 229 m above ground. Enjoy 360° views from the rooftop observation space "SKY STAGE," and special seasonal events are also held.
shibuya-sky.address: Shibuya Scramble Square, 2-24-12 Shibuya, Shibuya-ku, Tokyo

shibuya-hikarie.name: Shibuya Hikarie
shibuya-hikarie.description: A mixed-use commercial complex directly connected to Shibuya Station. In addition to ShinQs shops and restaurants, it features exhibition and event venues such as Hikarie Hall on the 9th floor, the creative space "8/" on the 8th floor, and d47 MUSEUM.

yoyogi-park.name: Yoyogi Park
yoyogi-park.description: A metropolitan park adjacent to Harajuku and Shibuya. The event plaza and outdoor stage host international festivals and ward festivals, mainly on weekends, and winter illuminations are also held.

ebisu-garden-place.name: Ebisu Garden Place
ebisu-garden-place.description: A mixed-use complex built on the former site of the Sapporo Beer factory. It features events at Center Plaza and Clock Plaza, and is home to the Tokyo Photographic Art Museum, Ebisu Garden Cinema, The Garden Hall, and more.

omotesando-hills.name: Omotesando Hills
omotesando-hills.description: A shopping complex along the zelkova-lined Omotesando avenue. In addition to shops and restaurants surrounding the open-air atrium's grand staircase, it hosts pop-ups and exhibitions at Space O on B3F.

meiji-jingu.name: Meiji Jingu
meiji-jingu.description: A Shinto shrine dedicated to Emperor Meiji and Empress Shoken. Surrounded by a forest of approx. 700,000 ㎡, it is one of the most visited shrines in Japan for New Year's first shrine visits (hatsumode). Festivals are held throughout the year, including the Spring and Autumn Grand Festivals.

topmuseum.name: Tokyo Photographic Art Museum
topmuseum.description: A public museum dedicated to photography and moving images, located inside Yebisu Garden Place. In addition to special exhibitions, it also holds screenings in the 1F hall.
topmuseum.address: Yebisu Garden Place, 1-13-3 Mita, Meguro-ku, Tokyo

line-cube-shibuya.name: LINE CUBE SHIBUYA (Shibuya Public Hall)
line-cube-shibuya.description: A hall next to Shibuya City Office. It hosts concerts, theater performances, the Shibuya Music Festival, and other events.

harakado.name: Tokyu Plaza Harajuku "HARAKADO"
harakado.description: A commercial complex at the Jingumae intersection. It houses culture-focused shops, restaurants, and a public bathhouse (sento), and also hosts pop-up events.

shibuya-109.name: SHIBUYA109 Shibuya
shibuya-109.description: A fashion building standing at the fork between Dogenzaka and Bunkamura Street. The event space in front of the store hosts stages for events such as the Shibuya Music Festival.

hachiko.name: Hachiko Statue
hachiko.description: A bronze statue in front of Shibuya Station's Hachiko Exit. A classic meeting spot and, along with the Scramble Crossing, a symbol of Shibuya.
hachiko.address: 2-1 Dogenzaka, Shibuya-ku, Tokyo (in front of Shibuya Station)

konno-hachimangu.name: Kanno Hachimangu Shrine
konno-hachimangu.description: A shrine associated with the Shibuya clan, from whom the name "Shibuya" is said to derive. During the annual festival in September, mikoshi (portable shrines) are carried through the streets of Shibuya.

fuglen-tokyo.name: FUGLEN TOKYO
fuglen-tokyo.description: The Tokyo branch of a coffee shop originally from Oslo, Norway. It operates as a coffee shop during the day and a cocktail bar at night, and is also known for its space furnished with vintage Nordic furniture.

maisen-aoyama.name: Tonkatsu Maisen Aoyama Main Store
maisen-aoyama.description: The flagship store of the tonkatsu restaurant Maisen, housed in a renovated public bathhouse. It serves Kurobuta (black pork) tonkatsu and seasonal set meals.
